correctness.rationale: Exact nine-vertex, twelve-line system, three distinguished colours and single-site moves are defined. The line-free arc argument proves every class has size at most four; the pair/incidence identity rules out two-colourings and classifies the strict bicolourings. Both standalone checked implementations enumerate all 19683 ternary words or equivalently all ordered partitions into line-free subsets, build all legal arcs of the recolouring graph, and run complete breadth-first search from every one of the 3762 states. Their identical fingerprints and full outputs establish one component, 16848 edges, radius nine, diameter ten, precise degree/eccentricity/type and strict-bicolouring-distance profiles. The exact proof is finite; no infinite extension or unexecuted certificate is asserted.

value.rationale: Single-site reconfiguration under the minimum weak colouring palette is a canonical constraint-dynamics question on the unique affine plane of order three. Exact connectedness and worst-case distance make the minimum palette computationally navigable rather than just existential; the structurally notable 162 strict bicolourings are mutually frozen if the strict constraint remains, yet are all connected without adding any colour upon allowing rainbow blocks. Exact degree/metric distributions provide a natural fully specified benchmark for hypergraph-colouring dynamics; the claim is not merely a recomputation of a known table.
